Subject: Discovery Call
Body: Scarlet said Terrapin Touring is consolidating security operations after acquiring six venues. The biggest issue is inconsistent processes and limited executive visibility. She wants a single operating model and a monthly executive-level view of security posture. Casey will own the technical rollout. The team would like to begin deployment in early October.

Subject: Technical Validation
Body: Casey confirmed SSO is required before broad rollout and asked that the first phase focus on the corporate environment before expanding to the venues. Terrapin Touring expects the Wall of Sound implementation team to help define the initial rollout plan. Casey said their identity team will need at least two weeks' notice for configuration work.

Subject: Commercial Review
Body: Scarlet agreed to the commercial terms and said she wants to show measurable progress to the CIO before the end of Q4. No specific success metrics were finalized. Jack requested the final order form and confirmed procurement is complete.
